Official Ans. by NTA (40)
Ans. (40)

$$\begin{array}{l}
\frac{1}{2} \times 2 \times \mathrm{v}^{2}=10000 \\
\Rightarrow \mathrm{v}^{2}=10000 \\

22. A block of mass 2 kg is attached with two identical springs of spring constant 20 N/m each. The block is placed on a frictionless surface and the ends of the springs are attached to rigid supports (see figure). The value of x is $\_\_\_\_$ .

Official Ans. by NTA (5)
Ans. (5)
Sol. $\mathrm{F}=-2 \mathrm{kx}, \mathrm{a}=-\frac{2 \mathrm{kx}}{\mathrm{m}}, \omega=\sqrt{\frac{2 \mathrm{k}}{\mathrm{m}}}=\sqrt{\frac{2 \times 20}{2}}$
$$\begin{array}{l}
=\sqrt{20} \mathrm{rad} / \mathrm{s} \\
\mathrm{~T}=\frac{2 \pi}{\omega}=\frac{2 \pi}{\sqrt{20}}=\frac{\pi}{\sqrt{5}} \\
\mathrm{x}=5
\end{array}$$
23. A hole is drilled in a metal sheet. At 27°C, the diameter of hole is 5 cm. When the sheet is heated to $177^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, the change in the diameter of hole is $\mathrm{d} \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~cm}$. The value of d will be $\_\_\_\_$ if coefficient of linear expansion of the metal is $1.6 \times 10^{-5} /{ }^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$.
Official Ans. by NTA (12)
Ans. (12)
Sol. $\quad \mathrm{d}_{0}$ at $27^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ \& $\mathrm{d}_{1}$ at $177^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$
$$\begin{array}{l}
\mathrm{d}_{1}=\mathrm{d}_{0}(1+\alpha \Delta \mathrm{T}) \\
\mathrm{d}_{1}-\mathrm{d}_{0}=5 \times 1.6 \times 10^{-5} \times 150 \mathrm{~cm} \\
=12 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~cm}
\end{array}$$
24. In the circuit shown in the figure, the ratio of the quality factor and the band width is $\_\_\_\_$ s.

Official Ans. by NTA (10)
Ans. (10)
Sol. $\Delta \omega=\frac{\mathrm{R}}{\mathrm{L}}$
$$\begin{array}{l}

\omega_{0}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3 \times 27 \times 10^{-6}}}=\frac{1}{9 \times 10^{-3}} \\
\frac{\mathrm{Q}}{\Delta \omega}=\frac{\omega_{0} \frac{\mathrm{~L}}{\mathrm{R}}}{\frac{\mathrm{R}}{\mathrm{~L}}}=\omega_{0} \frac{\mathrm{~L}^{2}}{\mathrm{R}^{2}}=\sqrt{\frac{1}{\mathrm{LC}}} \frac{\mathrm{~L}^{2}}{\mathrm{R}^{2}} \\
=\frac{1}{9 \times 10^{-3}} \times \frac{9}{100}=10 \mathrm{~s}
